main.description: A brand: how a Streamplace node looks on one hostname, and how apps built for it look. Keyed by the hostname. Generated from pkg/branding/vocab.go; do not edit by hand.

siteTitle.description: Name of the node, shown in the nav lockup, the browser tab and link cards.

siteDescription.description: One-line description for link cards and the page meta description.

networkName.description: What the app calls the social network viewers sign in with and share to.

networkProfileUrl.description: Where a chat user's profile link goes, with {handle} and {did} placeholders; default https://bsky.app/profile/{handle}.

cardSiteName.description: How link cards name the site in their titles: the {site} in the card templates below. Default siteTitle.

cardLiveTitle.description: Link-card title of a live stream page; {name} is the streamer's display name (their handle when unset), {handle} their handle, {site} cardSiteName. The description is the stream's post text.

cardHomeTitle.description: Link-card title of the front page (the live tab), e.g. "Live streams on {site}". Default siteTitle.

cardHomeDescription.description: Link-card description of the front page, e.g. "Watch live streams from verified accounts on {site}." Default siteDescription.

cardVideosTitle.description: Link-card title of the on-demand videos tab (/video).

cardVideosDescription.description: Link-card description of the on-demand videos tab.

cardVideoTitle.description: Link-card title of a video page; {name}, {handle} and {site} as in cardLiveTitle. The description is the video's title.

cardGoLiveTitle.description: Link-card title of the go-live tab (/live).

cardGoLiveDescription.description: Link-card description of the go-live tab.

loginPlaceholder.description: Example handle shown in the login form's empty handle field.

defaultStreamer.description: Handle or DID whose stream page is the node's front door (single-user nodes).

defaultVideo.description: A video whose page is the node's front door while set, over defaultStreamer: its at:// URI (at://did/place.stream.video/rkey) or its path (<handle-or-did>/video/<rkey>). Clear it to return the front door to the streamer.

accentColorLight.description: accentColor override for the light scheme.

backgroundColor.description: Page background (dark mode); raised surfaces and borders derive from it.

foregroundColor.description: Text color (dark mode); unset picks white or near-black to read on the background.

dangerColorLight.description: dangerColor override for the light scheme.

successColorLight.description: successColor override for the light scheme.

warningColorLight.description: warningColor override for the light scheme.

infoColorLight.description: infoColor override for the light scheme.

chatBadges.description: Badges beside chat names: all, only badges issued by badge definitions (no built-in streamer / moderator / bot marks), or none.

chatNameColors.description: Whether chat shows display names in each user's chosen color (on) or the default text color (off).

chatLayout.description: Chat message shape: compact one-line rows, or avatar rows with name, handle and time above the text.

mobileAppBanner.description: Whether the web app suggests the Streamplace mobile app on phones: the in-page banner and the iOS Smart App Banner meta tag. Default on; off for a node that is its own product.

socialHeading.description: Heading above the social links at the bottom of the sidebar.

sidebarBackgroundImage.description: Decorative image at the bottom of the sidebar.

linkBanner.description: OpenGraph image for the front page's link card (1200x630).

verifiedIcon.description: Badge shown beside verified chat users (SVG preferred); default a check in the primary color.

networkIcon.description: Icon on chat profile links to the network (SVG preferred); default the Bluesky butterfly.

socialIcon1.description: Custom icon for socialLinks (SVG preferred; use currentColor to take the sidebar's icon color).

socialIcon2.description: Custom icon for socialLinks (SVG preferred; use currentColor to take the sidebar's icon color).

socialIcon3.description: Custom icon for socialLinks (SVG preferred; use currentColor to take the sidebar's icon color).

socialIcon4.description: Custom icon for socialLinks (SVG preferred; use currentColor to take the sidebar's icon color).

appName.description: Product name of the built apps: the iOS/Android home-screen name, the desktop app, the docs. Default siteTitle.

appWordmark.description: Text beside the mark in the app's lockup; a . in it gets the accent treatment. Default appName.

appMonochrome.description: on when mainLogo is single-color art drawn with fill="currentColor", so the app can tint it. Default off.

appBundleId.description: iOS bundle identifier and Android package of the built app, reverse-DNS (com.example.live). SP_BUNDLE_OVERRIDE wins over it.

appHost.description: Hostname of the node the built app talks to by default, and the domain its universal/app links open (live.example.com). Default stream.place.

appStory.description: The mark's design story for the /brand guidelines page: {tagline, readingsIntro, readings, geometry, constructionNotes, specs, usage}.

appIcon.description: Full-bleed square app icon (SVG or 1024px PNG). Default: mainLogo at 62% on appColors.iconBackground.

appIconForeground.description: Android adaptive icon foreground; keep the art in the inner ~66%. Default: mainLogo at 45%.

appSplash.description: Splash screen logo, shown on appColors.splashBackground. Default: mainLogo at 50%.

appWordmarkImage.description: Wordmark lettering (SVG) for the downloadable lockup. Default: appWordmark set in type.

icon.description: A built-in icon name or, in socialLinks, socialIcon1..4.

appColors.description: Icon and splash colors of a built app; any CSS color.
